title: Silent Wake
description: Naval cyber-kinetic escalation — 15-turn simple collaborative exercise. Naval Group, February 2026.

content.briefing: You are the crew of a Frigate on independent transit to patrol sector Alpha-3. NLT 112000B arrival. Transit time approx. 6 hrs at planned speed 15 kts. Regional posture: heightened readiness. ROE: Weapons Tight. Intelligence indicates possible hostile naval presence in theatre with potential use of visual and electronic deception tactics. No escort assigned. All systems nominal. Organic helicopter joins upon arrival.
objectives: Maintain mission tempo through escalating anomalies
Identify and respond to AIS spoofing and cyber intrusion
Manage combat systems degradation under kinetic threat
Transition to post-crisis control with minimal residual risk

phases.title: Transit Phase
phases.description: Turns 1–3: In transit with emerging anomalies.

phases.title: Cyber Detection
phases.description: Turns 4–6: AIS spoofing confirmed, hostile contact, cyber signal.

phases.title: Escalation
phases.description: Turns 7–9: AAW malfunction, air threat, hostile salvo.

phases.title: Combat
phases.description: Turns 10–12: First hit, cyber root cause, new cyber alert.

phases.title: Recovery
phases.description: Turns 13–15: Hard choices, surface threat neutralised, end state.

events.title: Turn 1 — In Transit
events.description: Transit proceeding as planned. All systems nominal. No contacts of concern. EMCON: Navigation radar only.

role_descriptions.ops: Transit proceeding as planned. Estimated time to patrol sector unchanged. No updated intelligence from MTC. No declared maritime safety broadcasts affecting corridor. EMCON: Navigation radar only.
role_descriptions.nav: Course and speed steady at 15 kts. No deviation from planned route. Commercial traffic density within expected levels. ETA to patrol area: 5 hours. Visibility ~12 nm.
role_descriptions.eo: Radar performance nominal. Surface and air picture stable. No sensor anomalies observed. Communications functioning within expected parameters.
role_descriptions.cyop: Network traffic baseline unchanged. No alerts. Routine monitoring only.
role_descriptions.aawo: Air picture normal. No contacts of concern.
role_descriptions.pwo: Surface picture normal. No contacts of concern.

events.title: Turn 2 — Subtle Anomalies
events.description: Speed discrepancy detected. Ghost AIS contact bearing 035 / 18 nm with no radar echo or ESM emissions.

role_descriptions.nav: Minor speed discrepancy between GPS SOG and STW. One AIS contact bearing 035, range 18 nm with no corresponding radar echo.

events.title: Turn 3 — Faulty Component / Increased Traffic
events.description: Faulty speed component identified (ETBOL 5 min). AIS traffic density increasing beyond expected baseline.

role_descriptions.eo: Possible faulty component identified. Resolution: Restart (5 min ETBOL).
role_descriptions.nav: Increase in AIS contacts within sector. Commercial traffic density higher than expected baseline. Majority of contacts remain beyond visual range.

events.title: Turn 4 — AIS Spoofing Possible
events.description: First confirmed deceptive AIS track at bearing 041 / 11 nm. Component back online. Trust in AIS picture degrading.

role_descriptions.nav: New AIS contact bearing 041 at 11 nm. No vessel visible at this position.

events.title: Turn 5 — Cyber Alert & Comms Degradation
events.description: IBMS anomaly detected — first cyber signal, scope ambiguous. COMMS degrading: SATCOM bandwidth reduced, HF inconsistent.

role_descriptions.eo: SATCOM experiencing reduced bandwidth and intermittent connectivity. Observed throughput below allocated 512 kbps baseline. HF performance degraded. Signal clarity is inconsistent. Communication with MTC is not possible with UHF due to distance.

events.title: Turn 6 — Cyber Analysis & Hostile Ship Spotting
events.description: WECDIS → INS anomalous data flow detected. Warship contact confirmed at bearing 052 / 12 nm. ESM confirms non-commercial emissions.

role_descriptions.cyop: Analysis indicates anomalous data flow originating from WECDIS towards the INS. Effects are not yet fully determined.
role_descriptions.nav: New AIS contact bearing 052, range 12 nm. Visual silhouette indicates warship profile.
role_descriptions.pwo: ESM detects non-commercial radar emissions at bearing 052. Emission profile not consistent with merchant vessels.

events.title: Turn 7 — AAW Radar Malfunction
events.description: AAW radar online but tracks flickering — same symptom as pre-departure maintenance issue.

role_descriptions.aawo: Air surveillance radar online. Multiple tracks are flickering like last time.

events.title: Turn 8 — Air Threat Warning
events.description: MTC reports hostile aircraft inbound — ETA 15 min. AAW radar still not operational.

role_descriptions.aawo: Report via MTC (C2 system): Hostile aircraft approaching area (ETA: 15 min).
role_descriptions.eo: Reboot could fix the AAW issue (1 min ETBOL).

events.title: Turn 9 — Hostile Salvo
events.description: 3 incoming missiles detected. AAW radar restored. Target out of gun range. WECDIS attack unresolved.

role_descriptions.pwo: Target is out of gun range.

events.title: Turn 10 — First Blood
events.description: One missile intercepted. Two detonated nearby — CIWS FWD and missile launcher lost. HF antenna disabled. Target now in gun range.

role_descriptions.eo: FWD CIWS: non-operational (ETBOL: 2 hours). Missiles launcher: non-operational (ETBOL: 5 hours). 1 HF antenna was disabled (unable to repair).
role_descriptions.nav: Missiles (counterattack) missed the target. No evidence of hostile manoeuvre to evade.

events.title: Turn 11 — Cyber Analysis & Surface Tracking Malfunction
events.description: Cyber-attack confirmed — speed feed corrupted across all systems. Surface tracking radar unstable. Manual targeting reduces effective gun range.

role_descriptions.cyop: Analysis indicates a cyber-attack vector resulting in feeding all systems with wrong speed value. Option 1: Disconnect WECDIS and restart INS (ETBOL: 1 min) — WECDIS not available. Option 2: Restore WECDIS and restart INS (ETBOL 30 min) — WECDIS available.
role_descriptions.pwo: Target within the effective gun range. Surface tracking radar is unable to achieve a stable lock. Manual targeting reduces effective engagement envelope (reduced gun effective range).

events.title: Turn 12 — New Cyber Alert
events.description: AAW radar identified as cyber-attack source targeting surface tracking. Hostile aircraft ETA 10 min. Target 10 min from effective gun range.

role_descriptions.cyop: Malicious activity confirmed originating from AAW radar processing module toward surface tracking radar. Can affect tracking capability. Originated by the 'faulty' AAW radar component.
role_descriptions.aawo: Report via MTC (C2 system): Hostile aircraft approaching area (ETA: 10 min).
role_descriptions.pwo: Target is still out of effective gun range with manual tracking. 10 min to be in range.
role_descriptions.eo: INS functioning correctly. Speed inputs verified across systems.

events.title: Turn 13 — Hard Choices
events.description: AAW isolation restores surface tracking immediately. Hostile aircraft ETA 8 min. Surface threat must be neutralised first.

role_descriptions.cyop: AAW originated attack resolution options: Option 1: Restore AAW radar from backup (ETBOL: 30 min). Full recovery by replacing the component from storage and flashing clean firmware. Option 2: Isolate AAW radar: ETBOL < 1 min. AAW radar unavailable while isolated. Surface tracking stability restored immediately.
role_descriptions.aawo: Report via MTC (C2 system): Hostile aircraft approaching area (ETA: 8 min).

events.title: Turn 14 — Ship Neutralised — AAW Threat Focus
events.description: Hostile vessel neutralised. Surface threat eliminated. Air threat unresolved — AAW reconnection restores air picture.

role_descriptions.nav: Gun engagement achieved effective impact on hostile vessel. Target exhibiting loss of manoeuvrability.
role_descriptions.pwo: No further ESM emissions detected from hostile unit. Surface threat assessed as neutralised.

events.title: Turn 15 — Happy Ending
events.description: Hostile aircraft intercepted by friendly forces. All threats neutralised. Exercise complete — debrief to follow.

issues.title: Transit — All Systems Nominal
issues.description: All systems Green. NAV RADAR, IBMS/INS, COMMS ON. Weapons OFF.

issues.title: Speed Discrepancy + Ghost AIS Contact
issues.description: SOG vs STW mismatch. AIS contact bearing 035 / 18 nm with no radar echo.

issues.title: Faulty Speed Sensor Component
issues.description: Faulty component identified. Restart ETBOL 5 min.

issues.title: AIS Spoofing Detected
issues.description: AIS contact bearing 041 / 11 nm — no vessel at that position. Trust in AIS picture degrading.

issues.title: IBMS Anomaly — Possible Cyber Intrusion
issues.description: Anomalous data flow detected in IBMS. Scope ambiguous.

issues.title: COMMS Degraded (Yellow)
issues.description: SATCOM reduced bandwidth. HF signal inconsistent. UHF range-limited. COMMS → Yellow.

issues.title: Hostile Warship Contact — Bearing 052
issues.description: Visual warship profile at bearing 052 / 12 nm. ESM confirms non-commercial radar emissions. WECDIS → INS anomalous data flow detected.

issues.title: AAW RADAR Flickering (Yellow)
issues.description: Air surveillance radar online but multiple tracks flickering. Same symptom as pre-departure maintenance issue. AAW RADAR → Yellow.

issues.title: Hostile Aircraft Inbound — ETA 15 min
issues.description: MTC reports hostile aircraft approaching. ETA 15 minutes.

issues.title: 3 Incoming Missiles Detected
issues.description: 3 incoming missiles visually detected. Target out of gun range. AAW radar restored. WECDIS attack unresolved.

issues.title: Battle Damage — CIWS FWD + Missile Launcher Lost
issues.description: CIWS FWD non-operational (ETBOL 2 hrs). Missile Launcher non-operational (ETBOL 5 hrs). 1 HF antenna permanently disabled. Target now in gun range.

issues.title: Cyber Attack Confirmed — Speed Feed Corrupted
issues.description: WECDIS → INS attack confirmed. All systems fed wrong speed value. Option 1: Disconnect WECDIS + restart INS (1 min). Option 2: Restore WECDIS + restart INS (30 min).

issues.title: Surface Tracking Radar — Unstable Lock
issues.description: Surface tracking radar unable to achieve stable lock. Manual targeting reduces effective gun engagement range.

issues.title: AAW Radar Identified as Cyber Attack Source
issues.description: Malicious activity confirmed: AAW radar processing module attacking surface tracking radar. Root: reboot-triggered privilege escalation. Hostile aircraft ETA 10 min.
